newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end down on weak sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end down on weak sentiment.

text.p: Shanghai B shares ended lower on Wednesday with foreign investors bailing out of Shanghai Regrigerator Compressor and other blue chips seen posting disappointing profits, brokers said.
Domestic investors bought Shanghai Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone Development, which has a heavy index weighting, but that failed to offset weak market sentiment, they said.
The B index fell 0.564 point or 0.77 percent to 72.931 on volume of $9.896 million shares worth $4.330 million, against $3.482 million on Tuesday.

"Overseas funds are not willing buy with the short-term market direction uncertain," one broker said. "Concerns about interim results triggered the cutting of some positions and that pushed the index down."
"Technical charts showed a poor outlook for the market in the near term, but downward potential will be limited due to the fairly light trading volumes," a trader said.
Hainan Airlines fell $0.014 or 2.8 percent to $0.486 after its trading resumed on Wednesday afternoon. It was suspended in the morning session.
The company said on Wednesday it was seeking compensation of about $2.25 million from an aircraft maintenance company for damage to one of its planes during routine repairs.
Of the 45 B share issues, 39 were traded with 24 finishing lower while eight were higher and seven unchanged.
Huaxin Cement was the biggest B share loser on talk of poor interim results. It tumbled $0.014 or 9.72 percent to $0.130 on volume of 501,000 shares.
Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor was the most actively traded issue on institutional selling and it slid $0.012 or 2.99 percent to $0.388 on volume of 1.0 million shares.
Shanghai's A share index rallied on institutional support, but the short-term market direction is still unclear, brokers said.
The index closed up 28.398 points or 2.35 percent to 1,234.456 points on volume of 347.4 million shares worth 3.5 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index rose 64.068 points or 1.76 percent to 3,711.199 points.
Shanxi Xing Hua Cun Fenjiu Distillery was the star performer on speculative demand, climbing 0.55 yuan or 9.43 percent to 9.43 yuan on volume of 3.4 million shares.
